It fixes the data, universe, timing, books, costs, candidate signals, periods, screen, shortlist, primary and secondary test families, stop rule, bootstrap, reports owed, and limitations before any strategy return exists. tables_used.daily: crsp_dsf_v2 (dlyret, dlyprc, dlycumfacpr, dlycumfacshr, dlyprevdt, dlydelflg, dlyprcflg)

data.storage_and_publication: Working copy <local_data_root>/wrds_2025/ outside every Git checkout and outside iCloud sync; one tar backup under <private_data_root>/wrds_backup/. Git holds only a manifest and hashes. No raw provider row, membership list, security code, ticker list, company name, credential, or private path goes into Git. Noncommercial aggregates follow the owner data terms (R11).

seal.rule: In each table with a price or a return, rows whose economic date interval touches the window, or could touch it when a date is missing, are in wrds_2025/sealed/ and are never opened; their bytes are hashed only. Tables without a price or a return keep seal-dated rows in their main files. Rebalances whose windows touch the seal months stay typed missing. The first return after the seal, which starts at a seal-day close, is sealed too. No data after August 2026 (O-12).
seal.run_segments: the loader refuses a window across the seal (D9); a run crosses the seal only as separate segments; each segment's price path starts at its first priced row with index 1.0 (D3)
seal.source: O-12, O-18, O-22 in docs/decision_log.md (O-22 on branch claude/o22-wrds-grant); wrds_pull.py docstring; card_loader.md D9; research/m55_criteria.py CHECK_GAP_MONTHS (claude/m55-check-gap)

loader_rules.D1_identity: permanent_id = str(permno); the symbol is the same string; no return crosses PERMNOs (R3)
loader_rules.D2_calendar: the trading days of INDNO 1000200 in the main file; every member daily date is one of them, else refuse; a non-member row off the calendar is dropped and counted; no main row is in the seal
loader_rules.D3_prices: one close index per PERMNO and seal segment from dlyret only (CIZ includes the delisting return on the dlydelflg = 'Y' row; delret is never added); a missing dlyret is NaN; a later return is the last valid value times (1 + dlyret); a gap is handled by halt_gap_return_v1 (R5, R6)
loader_rules.D4_membership: crsp_dsp500list_v2, end date inclusive; engine end_date = mbrenddt + 1 day; start_known_at = mbrstartdt; end_known_at = mbrenddt (R2)
loader_rules.D5_market_equity: |dlyprc| at r - 1 times the shrout with the latest shrstartdt on or before (r - 1) - 136 calendar days, moved to the r - 1 basis by the dlycumfacshr ratio; reasons no_share_fact, stale_share_fact (that row's shrenddt before the cutoff), unmapped (no daily row at r - 1) (R1)
loader_rules.D6_disappearances: a member PERMNO with a crsp_stkdelists row whose price path ends before the last calendar row; effective_date = the calendar row after the last valued row, but never before the dlydelflg = 'Y' row date: when rows without a value lie between the last valued row and the 'Y' row, the event is effective on the first calendar row on or after the 'Y' row date and the position is held at its last value across the gap (amended by card_loader_fix_r1.md item 3, loader review GPT-M3); known_at = effective_date; delisting_return 0.0 when the CIZ delisting return is in the path, NaN when missing (engine default applies); cause cash_merger only for delactiontype MER and delpaymenttype CASH; failure for reasons BKPY, LP, SHLD, INSC, DELQ, FING, INSF, MVOT, MTMK, MVCHI, MVMF or action GLI; else unknown (R4)
loader_rules.D7_split_factors: CIZ cumulative factors fall at a split; the loader checks this on the data and refuses otherwise; only ratios between dates at or before t are used
loader_rules.D8_signal_inputs: daily from crsp_dsf_v2 (prc = |dlyprc|, cfacpr = dlycumfacpr, cfacshr = dlycumfacshr; shrout = the D5 count: the crsp_stkshares count with the latest shrstartdt on or before the row date - 136 calendar days, on the row's basis by the dlycumfacshr ratio, typed missing under the D5 reasons); members from D4; fund_annual from comp_snapshot_csa_pit (known_date = pitdate1); fund_quarterly and announcements from comp_urq; link from ccm_lnkhist; ibes_link from ibes_crsp_link; ibes from ibes_statsumu_epsus; index_daily from INDNO 1000200; a row with no known date or no fiscal key is dropped and counted by table
loader_rules.D9_seal: the loader refuses any sealed path; tilt_frames refuses a window across the seal
loader_rules.P1_path_break: a return whose dlyprevdt is a row with a price and no return is not in the path and is not filled; tilt_frames marks the next row in path_break; the driver blanks each level window (a price ratio or a maximum) that holds one and reports each held position across one with its weight
loader_rules.P2: a delisting-row return of -100 percent stays NaN in the path and is supplied as the delisting return
loader_rules.P3_eligibility: eligibility at the decision row t is mbrstartdt <= t < mbrenddt (the engine's interval mask; M5 rule resolved_universe_at_next_execution_row)
loader_rules.P4: the share count's basis is the first daily row on or after shrstartdt with a factor, on or before t; no valid close or factor at t, or no basis factor by t, is unmapped
loader_rules.P5: rows dropped and counted by table: no fiscal key, no known date, a known date before datadate, a fiscal key on two datadate values
loader_rules.P6: a zero dlyprc is no price and stays typed missing
loader_rules.P7: the 21 member PERMNOs whose path ends in 2019-07 without a delisting record do not reach a pre-seal window
loader_rules.P8_ibes_currency: IBES FY1 rows with a currency other than USD, or with no currency, are dropped before signal_inputs returns and counted by year (coordinator decision, card m55-loader-p9; committed at 17e86ff)
loader_rules.P9_s2_share_basis: option (a): the loader never reads URQ ajexq and supplies ajexq = 1.0 on every fund_quarterly row; each quarter's first-reported EPS is on the CRSP cfacshr basis of its own first known date (ASC 260) (coordinator decision, card m55-loader-p9; committed at 17e86ff)
loader_rules.source: coord/reports/m55_loader/card_loader.md (D1 to D9); decision log entry 'WRDS Loader Rules D1 to D9' on branch claude/m55-wrds-loader (P-1 to P-7); coord/reports/m55_loader/card_loader_p9.md and the loader decision log at 17e86ff (P-8, P-9); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 11 (OI-11); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 5 (Opus M3); coord/reports/m55_loader/card_loader_fix_r1.md item 3 (D6 timing, loader review GPT-M3)
loader_rules.bid_ask_midpoint_days: daily rows with dlyprcflg = 'BA' count as valid prices and returns; the share of member-days with 'BA' is counted in the report

benchmarks.confirm_and_check: SPY total return from its PERMNO's dlyret, from 1993-02
benchmarks.before_1993_02: CRSP S&P 500 value-weighted total return vwretd as is (legacy, to 2024-12-31), labelled 'gross of fund fees'; no fee is deducted
benchmarks.never: sprtrn, or INDNO 1000502 price returns, as a total return
benchmarks.cw_pit: CW-PIT: the cap-weight book on the same members, eligibility, events, and costs as the tilt
benchmarks.decomposition: tilt - SPY = (tilt - CW-PIT) + (CW-PIT - SPY); the second term is replication error (dropped members, full against float cap, SPY's fee); both terms are reported
benchmarks.source: card_trial_draft.md item 2; card_loader.md item 4; crsp_intake_design_note.md section 1; index_tilt_design_note.md section 2; signal_screen_design_note.md sections 2 and 5; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 2 (OI-02)

universe_and_timing.universe: point-in-time S&P 500 members from crsp_dsp500list_v2, identity by PERMNO, priced at r - 1; a member with me_missing (unmapped, ambiguous, multi_class, no_share_fact, stale_share_fact) or unpriced leaves both books at that rebalance; SPY keeps it, so it is replication error (R2, R6)
universe_and_timing.timing_contract: after_close_signal_next_observed_close_v1: at each month-end rebalance row r, cap weights, scores, eligibility, and the TE covariance use rows up to r - 1 only; both books trade at the close of row r and earn from row r + 1
universe_and_timing.rebalance: monthly; the last calendar row of each month in [start, end], without the anchor start; the first rebalance earns from the next month; monthly returns compound measured daily returns by calendar month
universe_and_timing.event_known_at_rule: a disappearance changes the target at r only when its known_at is at or before r - 1
universe_and_timing.b2_rule: The traded set at r is the target members minus the names that settle at r on an event first known at r; their held positions settle under R4 in both books. Scores, ranks, and the covariance stay at r - 1, and these names still count in the ranks of the others. CW-PIT renormalizes pro rata over the traded set; TILT (and the low-risk book) runs the same tilt, cap, and TE step on the traded set. Reported per rebalance: unknown_event_excluded and unknown_event_cw_share (over the r - 1 ME of all target members). A rebalance with no traded member refuses (traded_set_empty). An earlier known_at only with real evidence; no loader invents one.
universe_and_timing.source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 1; research/m55_index_tilt.py module docstring and rebalance_dates; decision log 'Index-Tilt Engine: Coordinator Defaults and the Delisting-at-Rebalance Rule' (O-20, O-21 context, PR #291); card_loader.md D4 and P-3; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 14 (OI-14); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 7 (Opus A4; OI-14 revised)
universe_and_timing.halt_at_window_end: if a held member has no close on a period's end row, the run refuses (halt_gap_return_v1) and the refusal is recorded; an amendment before any result of that run picks the fix

cw_pit.definition: b = cap weight from D5 market equity at r - 1 over the traded set

tilt.score: each signal is a percentile rank at row r - 1 with its declared sign (higher is better; the engine applies no sign); c = mean of (2u - 1) over the declared signal set; ties take the average rank; ranks are exact fractions; the rank pool is the book members with a valid value
tilt.weight: w = b x (1 + TILT_STRENGTH x c), TILT_STRENGTH = 0.5
tilt.te_target: ex-ante TE against CW-PIT <= 0.02 a year (TE_TARGET)
tilt.te_estimate: sqrt(252) x the ddof-1 standard deviation of the daily active return over the 252 rows ending at r - 1 (COV_ROWS = 252)
tilt.loop: tilt; cap; renormalize multiplicatively on the members free to tilt; repeat to max |w - b| <= cap + 1e-12 (CAP_TOLERANCE) in at most 100 passes (RENORMALIZE_LOOPS), else refuse; then scale w = b + s (w - b), s = min(1, 0.02 / TE); members pinned at b stay at b; TE_TOLERANCE 1e-9; BUDGET_TOLERANCE 1e-12
tilt.short_history: a member without a complete 252-row return window ending at r - 1 gets c = 0 and stays at b
tilt.min_valid: c = 0 when fewer than min_valid declared signals are valid; c = 0 is counted (c_zero_few_signals)
tilt.invalid_values: an infinite signal value refuses; a NaN is invalid for that signal only
tilt.source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 1; O-17 (Q1); research/m55_index_tilt.py constants and decision log 'Index-Tilt Engine: Coordinator Defaults' items 1 to 9; branch claude/m55-signal-sets e50e8d6 (signal_ids, min_valid, half_rule)

low_risk.role: judged only on test B; uses no screened return signal, so no screen or confirm month selects it (O-20)
low_risk.construction: power volatility tilt (a'): m_i = (s_i / s_med)^(-g); renormalize the free weights b m to the free cap weight; cap |w - b| at LOWRISK_CAP = 0.02 and renormalize until the cap holds (refuse after the loop limit); scale active weights down until ex-ante TE <= LOWRISK_TE = 0.05
low_risk.s_i: ddof-1 standard deviation of the 252 daily simple returns ending at r - 1; a member without a full window is pinned at w = b and counted
low_risk.s_med: median over the target members with a full window, the B2 excluded names included
low_risk.costs_events_halts: same as the tilt: R8 at 1x and 2x, R4 events, halt policy; runs through run_book

calibration.knob: g only; cap 0.02 and TE 0.05 are fixed hard limits
calibration.target: LOWRISK_TARGET_RATIO = 0.87: median over screen rebalances (1963-07 to 1992-12) of the ex-ante whole-book volatility ratio to CW-PIT
calibration.ratio: whole traded book on complete-case rows: the rows of the 252-row window ending at r - 1 where every traded member has a return; at least LOWRISK_RATIO_MIN_ROWS = 126 rows, else ratio_window_short; status defined_full (252 rows) or defined_partial; no fill, clip, or repair
calibration.choice: two-sided median bracket: undefined rebalances enter the median once at +inf and once at -inf; each g meets, fails, or is ambiguous. Order: a refusal below the first g that meets stops; then ratio_coverage_low (undefined share above LOWRISK_UNDEFINED_MAX = 0.10); then ratio_coverage_ambiguous (an ambiguous g below the first g that meets; the owner decides); then chosen (the first g that meets); else no_g_reaches_target (stop and ask the owner; the budget is not loosened)
calibration.window_diagnostic: treat every defined_partial rebalance as undefined and repeat the bracket classes and the choice without the coverage stop; window_sensitive only when that choice differs from the main decision; window_diag_coverage_high (diagnostic undefined share above 0.10) recorded apart
calibration.inputs: second moments only, ex-ante only; no realized portfolio volatility, mean return, Sharpe ratio, return gap, or realized portfolio return is computed
calibration.logged_per_g: every grid value with the share of rebalances where the cap binds, the TE scale is below 1, and members are pinned (R9)
calibration.order: coordinator default (logged): the calibration rule is frozen in this file first and the calibration runs after the freeze; this is stricter than the O-20 order (calibrate before the freeze)

low_risk.source: O-20; coord/reports/m6_prep/low_risk_design_note.md sections 3 and 4; coord/reports/m55_lowrisk/expert_decision.md (rules R-a to R-j and the addendum); decision log 'Low-Risk Book Calibration Rules' on branch claude/m55-lowrisk; research/m55_index_tilt.py LOWRISK_* constants at 6395511; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 10 (OI-10); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 10 (Opus A7)

costs.basis: one way, per traded notional, commission + spread bp, dated
costs.which_schedule: screen runs use SCREEN_COST_SCHEDULE only (no half-spread override); confirm and check runs use COST_SCHEDULE, which equals it from 1993-01-01, with the half-spread override
costs.half_spread_override: from the confirm period on, per stock and rebalance row: the half-spread is the higher of the spread of the dated schedule and the CRSP closing half-spread at r - 1; the 2x case doubles the result. It uses CRSP closing bid and ask from the owner's second WRDS pull, which follows the O-22 seal rule; the confirm run does not start before that pull
costs.split: the dated rate is split between the engine's transaction and slippage columns; annual turnover and cost drag include the first purchase from cash
costs.no_switch_cost: long only with fixed signal weights; no switch cost; no borrow cost (no shorts)
costs.reported: active turnover and cost drag per year
costs.source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 1 (Costs); signal_screen_design_note.md section 4 item 4; research/m55_index_tilt.py COST_SCHEDULE, COST_SCALES; research/m55_criteria.py SCREEN_COST_SCHEDULE; engine coordinator default 7; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 3 (OI-03); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 8 (Opus A5)

disappearance_r4.rule: one event set for both books; CRSP delisting return in the path when present; without it, last close for a cash merger and -100 percent otherwise (long only); timing in both modes: no settlement happens before the dlydelflg = 'Y' row date; when rows without a value lie between the last valued row and the 'Y' row, the event is effective and known on the first calendar row on or after the 'Y' row date
disappearance_r4.source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 1 (Disappearance); card_loader.md D6; research/m55_index_tilt.py EVENT_RUNS; coord/reports/m55_loader/card_loader_fix_r1.md items 3 and 4; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 3 (GPT-R1-03); coord/reports/m55_loader/card_loader_fix_r1.md item 3 (loader review GPT-M3)
disappearance_r4.last_close_rerun: the all-events R4 rerun uses the loader last_close mode: the return of every dlydelflg = 'Y' row is removed from the price path, so the path ends at the last trade close, and every event settles at that close (delisting_return = 0.0); no settlement happens before the 'Y' row date. The engine event-mode switch (EVENT_RUNS last_close) alone is not this rerun

candidates.universe_note: Each signal is computed at decision row t = r - 1 on point-in-time members; a value known on day k is usable from the first calendar row after k; first-reported Compustat values only (the first non-missing value of each item per record, usable from its known date plus one trading row); each cell holds a finite value or one typed reason; nothing is filled, clipped, winsorized, or dropped.
candidates.backfill: annual signals need two fiscal years known at t (MIN_ANNUAL_RECORDS = 2); S2 and S3 need eight quarters known at t (MIN_QUARTER_RECORDS = 8)
candidates.links: CRSP-Compustat primary date-valid links (one-to-one at t, else ambiguous_link); IBES ticker to PERMNO resolved at each statpers with score <= 1 (R3)

list.name: 3-month FY1 EPS revision / price
list.definition: 3 x the mean of the valid one-month FY1 revisions of the last three statistics months (at least 2); each revision = (FY1 mean at month m - FY1 mean at m - 1) / price at the m - 1 month end, one share basis
list.source_data: IBES unadjusted summary, CRSP split factors, same FPEDATS
list.usable_from: the first month-end row after the statistics date

list.name: earnings surprise, seasonal random walk
list.definition: (EPS q - EPS q-4) / sd of the eight prior such differences (at least 6), first-reported EPS, on the cfacshr share basis of q (P-9 option (a))
list.history_rule: an S2 quarter is read only when the PERMNO has a cfacshr row at the basis date; a new listing has no S2 value for about 2.5 to 3 years

list.name: announcement return, days -1 to +1
list.definition: stock minus INDNO 1000200 compound return over rows -1 to +1 around the latest announcement usable at t

list.name: accruals
list.definition: ((d act - d che) - (d lct - d dlc - d txp) - dp) / mean(at, at lag)

list.name: net share issuance, 12 months
list.definition: log(shrout x cfacshr at the month-end anchor before t's month) - log(the same 12 months earlier); shrout is the D5 count (D8): the latest shrstartdt on or before the anchor date - 136 calendar days, on the anchor row's basis
list.source_data: CRSP shares, the D5 count on the daily signal-input table, read at the month-end anchor

list.name: book-to-market
list.definition: Fama-French book equity / (price x shares at the month-end anchor); shares is the D5 count (D8): the latest shrstartdt on or before the anchor date - 136 calendar days, on the anchor row's basis; be <= 0 is be_nonpositive
list.source_data: first-reported annual (Compustat Snapshot); ME with the D5 share count at the month-end anchor

candidates.drop_rule: a signal with no first-reported WRDS source is dropped before the screen and the drop is recorded, not replaced
candidates.real_start: each month-end rebalance row is labelled by the return month it forms (the row dated in month m - 1 forms month m). The real-start panel is the return months 1963-01 to 1992-12 (30 full years; rows dated 1962-12 to 1992-11). The driver indexes the coverage panel by return month before it calls research/m55_signals.real_start on that panel: the first year from which every year to 1992 is complete and has at least 80 percent of members valid in every month (COVERAGE_NUMERATOR / COVERAGE_DENOMINATOR = 4 / 5). Real-start year Y means the screen series starts at the later of Y-01 and 1963-07 and ends at 1992-12. Fewer than 36 months gives the typed undefined record (OI-05). Coverage is a validity count, not a return; coverage counts per year come before any return

family_a_baseline.signs: Family A orients each so higher is better (the M5 signs)
family_a_baseline.role: runs once as a counted baseline composite (Q2) over the screen, confirm, and check periods, all visible (after screen_empty, the screen period only); a member of the secondary family; decides nothing; not a candidate
family_a_baseline.source: signal_screen_design_note.md section 3; research/m4_7_family_a.py FAMILY_A; research/m55_index_tilt.py MIN_VALID_SIGNALS; RESUME.md 0h (signal sets review A-3); coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md items 6, 7, 12 (OI-06, OI-07, OI-12)

screen_and_shortlist.record: annual mean = 12 x the monthly mean; TE = ddof-1 monthly sd x sqrt(12); HAC t = newey_west_mean_tstat with lag floor(4 (n / 100)^(2/9)); one-sided p = norm.sf(t); a zero or undefined TE or t gives a typed record status undefined that fails and stays hashed

test_A.statistic: confirm period, net of dated costs: composite minus SPY and composite minus CW-PIT, each a one-sided HAC t; intersection-union: p_A = the larger one-sided p
test_A.met_when: Holm-adjusted p_A <= 0.05; both confirm annual means > 0; both means > 0 at 2x costs; neither check-period annual mean < 0

test_B.statistic: confirm period: HAC non-inferiority t of (low-risk - SPY) + NI_MARGIN / 12 with NI_MARGIN = 0.005 a year, p_NI = norm.sf(t); volatility ratio vol(low-risk) / vol(SPY); paired moving-block bootstrap p_vol = share of draws with ratio >= 1.0; p_B = max(p_NI, p_vol)
test_B.met_when: Holm-adjusted p_B <= 0.05; ratio <= VOL_RATIO_MAX = 0.90; bootstrap 95th percentile < BOOTSTRAP_UPPER_MAX = 1.0; check-period annual gap > -0.005; check-period ratio < CHECK_VOL_RATIO_MAX = 1.0

bootstrap.method: paired moving-block, 12-month blocks, no wrap, starts uniform on 0 to n - 12, ceil(n / 12) blocks cut to n

limitations: Point-in-time Compustat (Snapshot) starts about 1986-12, so S2, S4, S5, S6, and S8 have about five screen years (1987 to 1992) before the backfill and 6-month lags. S3 needs eight known quarters with RDQ from comp_urq, so its screen may be short too; the real-start rule handles it. S1 (IBES from 1976) and S7 are not affected; the confirm period is fully covered. Source: decision log 'Signal-Screen Criteria Module', WRDS source facts; card_loader.md D8; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 11.

Survivor and drop bias: a member with me_missing or no price leaves both books; on real_v2 step 4b, 6.37 percent of pre member-days were unmapped but 9.49 percent for later delisting candidates, so the drop removes more later failures and biases both books up. CRSP intake: unmapped member-days are 1,166 of 423,341 for later failures against 271 of 2,967,375 for current members. Source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 1; intake_report.md.

Backfill bias: Compustat signals need two fiscal years known at t (S2 and S3 eight quarters); S2 needs CRSP history at the basis date, so new listings have no S2 value for about 2.5 to 3 years, which favors seasoned firms. Source: signal_screen_design_note.md section 3; decision log 'Signals S1 to S8 Rules'.

Low power: rule A detects about 0.72 percent a year at 50 percent power and 1.08 at 80 percent over 254 months at 2 percent realized TE; an IR of 0.3 (0.6 percent a year) is found about 39 percent of the time, about 30 percent under Holm with two tests; the two-sided BY family of 2 detects about 1.0 to 1.4 percent a year. 'A not met' often means 'not shown'. Source: signal_screen_design_note.md section 7; index_tilt_design_note.md appendix; O-20.

The half-spread override needs CRSP closing bid and ask, which the first pull did not include; the screen runs without it, and the confirm run waits for the owner's second WRDS pull. Source: RESUME.md section 0h backlog; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 3.

Test B: an ex-ante ratio near 0.87 gives a beta near 0.88, which under a 5 to 6 percent equity premium predicts a return gap of about 0.6 to 0.7 point a year, past the 0.5 margin; B passes only if the low-risk effect pays about one point a year in 1993-2014. Source: low_risk_design_note.md section 3.

A defined_partial low-risk ratio cannot measure risk on rows before a member existed; such windows are declared, counted (ratio_rows_leading, ratio_rows_gap), and checked by window_sensitive. Source: expert_decision.md, residual limitation.

Factor-level reuse: the signals come from papers on these months and M5 step 2 screened factor returns built from the same stocks; results are 'stock-level out-of-sample, factor-level in-sample'. Source: O-17 Q3.
CW-PIT uses full market cap, while S&P used float cap from 2005; with the me_missing drops and SPY's fee, CW-PIT - SPY is replication error. Source: index_tilt_design_note.md section 2.

Seal: the check period leaves out CHECK_GAP_MONTHS 2019-07 to 2021-08 (26 months): the seal holding months, 2020-08 (the 2020-07-31 row is sealed, so the first post-seal rebalance is 2020-08-31), and the warm-up to the first month end with a full 252-row window (2021-08-31; 251 post-seal rows on 2021-07-30, 273 on 2021-08-31); windows that touch the seal stay typed missing. Source: O-12, O-18, O-22; coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_fix_r1.md item 13 (Round 2 Decision, R2-M1).
The seal does not stop price levels on both sides from implying the net change across it; no script computes it. Source: wrds_pull.py docstring, residual limits.
WRDS tables without a price or a return keep seal-dated rows in their main files. Source: O-22.
Low-risk bootstrap percentile bound is slightly liberal (about 6 to 7 percent size at a true ratio of 1.0). Source: decision log 'Signal-Screen Criteria Module' default 3.
The pre-1993 benchmark vwretd is gross of fund fees, so it sits above an investable fund. Source: coord/reports/m55_trial/card_trial_defaults.md item 2.
